body: Market lens: ang mahalagang distinction dito ay capacity signal versus earnings signal. The article verifies real upstream investment across InP substrates and epiwafers, pero wala pang disclosed Sumitomo volume, utilization, backlog, o named customers. So for Japan equities, this strengthens the medium-term AI-photonics supply-chain narrative, but hindi pa sapat para infer broad earnings uplift. Mas convincing kapag may follow-through sa design wins, utilization, at supplier pricing power—not just capex headlines.

claims.text: The verified capacity build strengthens the medium-term Japan AI-photonics supply-chain narrative, but the article does not yet establish broad earnings uplift.
claims.basis: Inference from article facts showing real capacity investment alongside missing volume, utilization, backlog and customer disclosures.
